note: Panic/unwrap ratchet. `counts` may only go down; runtime_hooks_allowed is an explicit allowlist of KNOWN block-hook panics that are scheduled to be removed — it is not a target state, and it should trend to empty. `scanner_sha256` is the scanner this baseline was measured with: the audit refuses to compare a count taken by a different scanner, because a scanner change can move the number in either direction without any code changing. Refresh with scripts/mainnet/panic_unwrap_audit.sh --update-baseline, and say why in the commit message if a count increases.
